motivation: Inspection after structural verification found inherited quoted questions (not truth-apt descriptions), explicit temporal cores combined with conflicting outer times, and other-person/fictional cores under SELF wrappers. Do not admit the full expansion merely because source labels were conserved.
selection: Prospectively restrict this additional-data slice to 22 explicitly listed present first-person declarative cores per language and outer SELF/CURRENT only. No labels or text change. Preserve all eight variants and matched original repetitions for each retained parent. No selection uses model outputs.
operator_author_review: All 32 operators were inspected as author-written intended stance equivalents. AFFIRMED explicitly confirms truth; NEGATED explicitly rejects truth; UNCERTAIN leaves truth unresolved; RETRACTED withdraws the actual prior statement. The two negation-marker forms per stance contain explicit final disambiguation. This is not independent linguistic validation.
core_author_review: The retained statements describe current first-person states/actions, including current worry about tomorrow and current difficulty with a past calculation. They are not bare questions or directly third-person/fictional descriptions. An inner negation or uncertainty may remain inside an explicitly asserted quoted proposition. Ordinary task difficulty retains the original controlled benign label; no clinical conclusion is claimed.
limitations: The full original training population already contains these parent ambiguities; this curation prevents multiplying them as extra training, and does not repair or revalidate the original corpus.
Excluded samples are not automatically mislabeled. The selection is a conservative author judgment.
The narrow SELF/CURRENT slice cannot establish generalization to OTHER, FICTIONAL, PAST or HYPOTHETICAL.
Candidate labels are inherited synthetic gold, not independently annotated real-world truth.
No data is fitted or automatically admitted by this curation. A matched fitting experiment still needs a prospective protocol.
